org.tag: For your patient or self-help organisation
org.title: A new programme that works and proves its impact

items.title: Reach more people
items.text: A modern, professional programme under your name and brand that reaches members where they are. On secure, scalable infrastructure in Switzerland that grows with your peer community.

items.title: Prove your impact
items.text: Reports from day-to-day operation, for your board, foundations and funding reports.

items.title: Predictable effort
items.text: Clear steps, clear roles and a budget you know in advance. We take care of the technology, hosting and maintenance.

mitglieder.tag: For your members and target groups
mitglieder.title: Finding someone who understands what it’s like

items.title: Thoughtfully matched
items.text: Professionals suggest a person with a similar experience. Not chance, not an algorithm alone.

items.title: Protected and anonymous if preferred
items.text: Members decide for themselves what they share.

items.title: Whenever and wherever it suits
items.text: Online and from anywhere, including between appointments and alongside care, work or family.
